    BO13a Lemma 6: the set-up (figure 6.0) #

    Let σ : x → y₀ and ρ : x → y₁ be long neighbours of a crown (neither factors through the other) whose contours (α v, β w) and (α v', β' w') share the first arrow α. Among the morphisms φ out of x with α ⪯ φ ⪯ σ, ρ there is a greatest one ψ (two incomparable maximal ones would give a crown in x/P, Lemma 4 a)). Then σ = ψ u₂, ρ = ψ u₂', and (ψ u₂, β w), (ψ u₂', β' w') are contours (RayQuiver.MulBasis.exists_l6Data). A common first arrow exists because at most three arrows leave x (not_four_irr).
